question: Can another tool-capable weak model family execute the already-frozen deliberative browser-use harness on the original five easy Amazon scenarios?

relationship_to_parent.trigger: The first three scheduled Qwen treatment runs all ended before browsing after exhausting the frozen four-attempt literal-contract compiler. Two terminal compiler errors contained malformed JSON and one contained an upstream request timeout. This supplement measures compatibility with a separately named model; it does not redraw Qwen or repair the parent cohort.

historical_context.role: descriptive headroom only; not a contemporaneous causal control
historical_context.source: results/overhaul_lb, exact browseruse graded/combined slice over the original five scenarios

interpretation.compatibility_read: Successful contract compilation and nonzero browser actions establish that the frozen harness can be executed by this additional model family; strict hero purchases additionally measure preference fidelity.
interpretation.prohibited_claim: GPT-4o results must never replace Qwen results, enter Qwen's denominator, or retroactively convert the parent campaign into a model-randomized comparison.
limitations: Five scenarios with one run each measure breadth, not run-to-run variance.
The supplementary cohort was motivated by observed Qwen compatibility failures and is therefore an explicitly outcome-informed follow-up.
Historical browser-use values establish headroom but do not identify a causal harness effect.
Any safety or lossy context ceiling exposure must be reported.
